name: Invaders of Alterac Valley
label: Quest
description: Invaders of Alterac Valley: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Listen up, friend. No matter what you might have heard about the battle raging in Alterac Valley, one thing remains true: the Stormpike Expedition invaded Frostwolf Territory. The day we allow the Alliance to invade Horde lands without a forceful response is the day I hang up my axe and live the rest of my life in shame. Go forth and expel the invaders!

clips.title: Progress
paras: What news do you bring from the lands of the Frostwolves? How does the battle for Alterac Valley fare?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in Alterac Valley! I will tell my superiors of your deeds.
